claim: For an AWS service action, API Gateway offers the AWS integration of the non-proxy type only; the Lambda proxy integration supports a streamlined integration setup with a single Lambda function.
question: Can you use a proxy integration to call an AWS service action, and what does the Lambda proxy integration support?

values.display: AWS integration of the non-proxy type only
streamlined integration setup with a single Lambda function

evidence.quote: For an AWS service action, you have the AWS integration of the non-proxy type only.
The Lambda proxy integration supports a streamlined integration setup with a single Lambda function.
